instruction: A candid full-shot photograph of a bright indoor ballet studio with a light curtain. The woman in the black leotard (R1) stands directly behind the young girl in the pink tutu (R2), gently holding her arms to guide her posture. The young girl (R2) stands in profile facing left, with her arms extended forward and down, while the instructor (R1) looks down at her with a focused expression. Soft, natural light illuminates the scene from the side, creating a gentle, focused atmosphere with a neutral color palette and a shallow depth of field.
